name: Onedari ShareMate
original_name: おねだりシェアメイト
source:
Sakaiya Ayumi, 25 years old, who dislikes men a bit, is a teacher working for the private Futaba Academy. Having already been thinking about leaving her parents' place, Ayumi decides to rent a room in a sharehouse called "Perche", after being offered by her older brother-in-law, Kai Shintarou, its owner.

"I wonder what the two people already living here are like?"

With high hopes resting in her heart, Ayumi opens Perche's door... and a certain something jumps into her field of vision-

"My housemates are all men?!"

Like this, Ayumi's life with her two male housemates begin...

What awaits? A sweet love? A sordid love affair? A love triangle?

Who are the two housemates you'll choose?

The story will change depending on who you'll choose as your roomates in this romance AVG!

[Translated from [url=http://asring.1000.tv/story.html]The Official Website[/url]]
translation:
堺屋步美，25岁​​，有点不喜欢男人，是私立双叶学园的一名教师。步美已经考虑离开父母的住处，在她的姐夫、业主甲斐新太郎的提议下，步美决定在一家名为“Perche”的合租屋里租一间房间。

“不知道已经住在这里的两个人怎么样了？”

怀着厚望，步美打开了Perche的门……某种东西跃入了她的视野——

“我的室友都是男人？！”

就这样，亚由美和她的两个男室友的生活开始了……

等待着什么？甜蜜的爱情？一段肮脏的恋情？三角恋？

你会选择谁作为两个室友？

故事会根据你在这部浪漫AVG中选择谁作为室友而改变！
